title: Nf Opt Om Tail
objective: Complete generic higher-residual OM and scalable MaxMin for vector429-class tails, with exact certificates and a measured selector-ready auto-eligibility handoff
references: Guàrdia, Montes, and Nart, Higher Newton polygons and integral bases
Poteaux and Weimann, Fast computation of integral bases

handoff.summary: Generic nonlinear residual fields now use exact squarefree, DDF, and deterministic EDF factorization; arbitrary positive-degree prime-field higher factors are supported, vector429 completes exactly at p=2,3,5,7, and a measured complete/native p=7 selector region is exposed without changing the central engine.
risks: Nested nonlinear-on-nonlinear residue towers and repeated nonlinear higher factors remain explicitly incomplete and fail closed.
The number-field-algorithms package owns 731480 source bytes after this lane, 6480 above its current shared lazy-package ratchet.
next_steps: Register packed_maxmin_valuations_are_maximal and packed_triangular_basis_is_closed in the production native-kernel registry.
In the central engine, dispatch only when the completed certified result has selector.auto_selectable true; retain the existing local path otherwise.
Resolve the shared number-field-algorithms byte ratchet in the integration lane.
